EventDescription.semantic_note: Plain-language event description, no acronyms without expansion.

EventType.semantic_note: Drives the regulatory routing in Module 3.

JurisdictionOfEvent.semantic_note: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Drives non-CFTC regime applicability.

SettlementDate.semantic_note: Replaces NotionalSchedule.MaturityDate semantics for binary payoff contracts.

ContractSize.semantic_note: Per-contract payout in settlement currency on YES outcome.

EntryPrice.semantic_note: Implied probability at execution; constrained to (0,1).

SettlementCurrency.semantic_note: Validated against ISO 4217 in this engine. Stablecoin settlement, such as USDC, would require a separate controlled vocabulary before production activation.

HedgingExposureType.semantic_note: Schema extension proposal: this attribute does not exist in current UPI taxonomy and is the substantive contribution of Module 4. Determines whether the position is reportable to the SDR or routed to gambling-regulation under the host jurisdiction.

PlatformType.semantic_note: Structured enum (not free text) to support deterministic regime routing in Module 3. The CFTC CONDITIONAL flag triggers on CFTC_REGULATED_DCM or DCM.

UnderlyingEconomicExposure.semantic_note: Free-text justification for HedgingExposureType. Not parsed but retained for SDR audit.

ResolutionSource.semantic_note: Named public source or oracle used to resolve the event, e.g. BLS, ESMA, MAS, official election authority.

OutcomeMetric.semantic_note: Observable metric such as vote share, CPI value, policy decision or regulatory classification.

ParticipantRestrictionType.semantic_note: Proposed field to separate hedging/professional use from open retail wagering.

MustReferenceObservableSource.rule: EventDescription must reference a public, named, third-party data source (e.g. Bundestag, BLS, ESMA, MAS, IPCC, FIFA) sufficient for unambiguous resolution. Engine implementation: surface as a manual-review flag rather than auto-fail, since natural-language enforcement is out of scope.
MustReferenceObservableSource.rationale: Blocks contracts on unfalsifiable propositions and aligns with the ISDA Credit Definitions practice on Successor / Reference Entity identification.

EntryPriceWithinUnitInterval.rule: 0 < EntryPrice < 1 strictly; 0 and 1 are degenerate cases not reportable as binaries.

HedgingExposureMustBeJustified.rule: If HedgingExposureType == HEDGING, UnderlyingEconomicExposure must be present and reference an identifiable balance-sheet exposure of the reporting counterparty.
HedgingExposureMustBeJustified.rationale: Prevents trivially flagging speculative positions as hedges to access reduced-margin treatment.
